item.title: The Three Pillars of JavaScript Bloat
item.description:
📝 Cross-realm values Lastly, we have cross-realm values. Why this is a problem All of this makes sense for a very small group of people. We don’t need to support pre-ES5 environments, we don’t pass values across frames, and we uninstall packages which break the environment.
🔗 Read more: https://43081j.com/2026/03/three-pillars-of-javascript-bloat
